description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com http://partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/partechnology/, X (formerly Twitter) https://twitter.com/par_tech, Facebook https://www.facebook.com/parpointofsale/, and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/partechnology/.



Position Description:
PAR is looking for a Software Developer to support cloud engineering operations and active software development projects. This role is ideal for someone with a strong software engineering or cloud infrastructure background who has experience with cloud operations, automation, and modern development practices. The Software Developer will contribute to highly technical software projects, help troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, and identify opportunities to improve products, systems, interfaces, business processes, and overall performance.
This role will work closely with a cross-functional team including other engineers, QA, developers, business analysts, technical leads, the Head of Product, and the Development Manager. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new technologies and is passionate about continually improving development practices.

Position Location:
Remote (United States)

Reports To:
Development Manager and Development Team Leader

What We’re Looking For:

 - 3+ years of experience working on desktop applications.

 - Strong software engineering or cloud infrastructure background with a solid understanding of technical cloud operations and automation.

 - Experience with cloud-based infrastructure and services such as Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

 - Strong scripting skills using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Perl, and Ansible.

 - Understanding of networking and network security.

 - Ability to ensure operational quality is incorporated into software delivery projects.

 - Willingness to learn and adopt new technologies as needed.

 - Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Additional skills:

 - Ability to evaluate and implement solutions that improve system performance and business process efficiency.

 - Experience reviewing code and solutions to ensure development best practices are followed.

 - Experience providing coaching, mentoring, or knowledge-sharing opportunities to other developers.

 - Strong understanding of development practices and standards.

 - Ability to identify opportunities to improve products, systems, interfaces, and business processes through technology.

Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:

 - Troubleshoot technical issues and develop and implement remediation plans.

 - Perform hands-on software development, including writing and reviewing code.

 - Ensure cloud technologies are being used efficiently and that solutions meet established quality standards.

 - Identify and deliver technology solutions that improve products, systems, interfaces, business processes, and performance.

 - Support other software developers through coaching, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing opportunities.

 - Contribute to improving development capabilities across the team and organization.

 - Champion a positive development culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Determine appropriate automation and tooling approaches for build, release, and container platforms.

 - Determine when solutions and code changes are ready to move to the next stage of delivery.

 - Identify when technical issues or risks should be escalated to the Development Manager and Team Lead.

 - Help identify opportunities to improve products, systems, and business processes through technology.

Interview Process:
Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
Interview #2: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams)
Interview #3: Video interviews with the Team (via MS Teams)
